meta.title: The Will of a Mother with Dementia

context.description: A mother in late-stage dementia left a will that splits the estate 60% to the younger son and 40% to the elder. The elder son, Yoon Tae-seong, who lived with their mother and cared for her, refuses to accept the ratio. The younger son keeps his composure to the very end.
context.triggerAmplifier: Repeated visits, a switched care worker, and a notarised copy that does not match the handwritten draft are stacked one over the other. At first the suspicion runs straight at the younger son's influence over their mother's final wishes; the more clues are uncovered, the more the picture shifts, and what neither side has spoken about begins to surface.
